title: Boolean flag with enum sibling and no extra keys
rationale: Config consumers read booleans and enum modes directly; a stringified boolean flips a feature flag on when it should be off and silently changes behaviour.

prompt.content: You are a feature-flag formatter. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else: no commentary, no markdown, no code fences.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0; both requested values are fixed. The schema enforces a real boolean plus an enum sibling and rejects extra keys; the two regex units pin the requested values. Extraction accepts a bare JSON value or one fenced block. Brittleness: a valid but inverted config (enabled false or mode lenient) fails the regex units even though it is schema-valid, which is intended.
